home.noData: Log the first day of your next period with the + button, and predictions will start from there.

disclaimer: This app gives estimates only. It is not a method of contraception and does not replace medical advice.

onboarding.notSure: Not sure? Keep the suggestion. The app learns from what you log and adjusts.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.text: A cosy place to keep track of your cycle. Everything you enter stays on this phone.

lastPeriod.title: When did your last period start?
lastPeriod.text: The first day of bleeding counts as day 1.
lastPeriod.label: First day of your last period

cycleLength.title: How long is your cycle, usually?
cycleLength.text: Count from the first day of one period to the day before the next.

periodLength.title: How many days does your period usually last?

homeScreen.title: Add Cycle to your home screen
homeScreen.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
homeScreen.step3: From now on, open Cycle from that icon.
homeScreen.why: Your entries are saved in the home-screen app, separately from Safari.

calendar.hint: Tap a day to log your period, mood or symptoms.

backup.title: Backup
backup.text: Your entries are stored only on this phone. Save a backup now and then, for example to Files or in a chat with yourself, so you can get them back on a new phone.
backup.saveFailed: The backup couldn't be saved. Try again.

restore.confirmText: This replaces everything on this phone with the backup: {{periods}} and {{logs}}.

cycle.title: Your cycle
cycle.text: Used for predictions until enough periods are logged; after that the app uses your own averages.

delete.title: Delete all data
delete.text: Removes every entry and setting from this phone.
delete.confirmText: This can't be undone. Save a backup first if you might want your entries back.

insights.noSymptoms: Symptoms you log will show up here, grouped by phase.

patterns.title: Your patterns
patterns.lowMood: Your mood tends to be lower in your {{phase}} phase.
patterns.empty: Patterns appear after a couple of cycles of logging.
patterns.note: Based only on what you've logged. Not medical advice.

symptoms.cramps: You tend to have cramps in your {{phase}} phase.
symptoms.headache: You tend to get headaches in your {{phase}} phase.
symptoms.bloating: You tend to feel bloated in your {{phase}} phase.
symptoms.acne: You tend to notice acne in your {{phase}} phase.
symptoms.tired: You tend to feel more tired in your {{phase}} phase.
symptoms.cravings: You tend to have more cravings in your {{phase}} phase.
